name: contrabass
description: Jewelbox 28 Contrabass: the BOW is the striker (pernambuco stick flush with the contact face, white hair, ebony frog with pearl eye, ivory tip), crossing the strings of a BIG near-black double bass with sloping shoulders standing upright behind it (tall neck and scroll, f-holes, bridge, strings, end-pin) - bowed, unlike the plucked, lying acoustic bass (21).
